zack: quick flag  canary runtime 3.3 + SDK 2.8.1 triggers rare decode errors on quant-v3b (>2048). proposing eu-west pin to 3.2.1 until patch.
nina: How frequent? user impact?
zack: ~0.2%-0.5% on longseq internal canary, token skips/dup leading to malformed responses. Targeted customers only.
rajeev: Region-only pin + short TTL sounds good. Also add auto-reroute to v3a if decode_errors spike.
tian: I'll run regen-suite against pinned runtime and post quick diffs.

zack: deploybot command (suggested):
```bash
/deploybot pin add --model quant-v3b --runtime 3.2.1 --regions eu-west --ttl 6h --reason "decode regression with runtime 3.3 on longseq"
```

deploybot: executing pin workflow -> applying to 30 nodes in eu-west.
deploybot: PIN APPLIED model=quant-v3b runtime=3.2.1 regions=[eu-west] nodes=30 ttl=6h id=pin-8123

rajeev: I'll configure reroute policy reroute-91: if decode_errors>40/min for 10m, route quant-v3b->quant-v3a. Attaching alert alert-442.
tian: smoke started, will report in 8m.
ops-bot: posted notice to #ops and updated release-notes draft: "Temporary regional runtime pin (pin-8123) due to decode regression; fallback to quant-v3a on errors."
zack: thanks team. plan: monitor 60m QA window, patch runtime 3.3.2 tomorrow morning. remove pin once verified.
